item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Channel Wharf: The Channel Wharf page now describes the Design Controls…
item.description: The Channel Wharf page now describes the Design Controls as envisioning a paved open space that stays a functioning wharf with public access, public art and seating, recommends a large-scale industrial object or similar feature and permits one art piece. It no longer says the design is 'consistent with Public Trust uses', which Section 3.5 does not state. Source: Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24, 2018, Section 3.5 p.68 and Section 3.4 p.66 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Channel Wharf: The map notes said the wharf is unbuilt and a working…
item.description: The map notes said the wharf is unbuilt and a working wharf or staging area today, and cited the Design Controls for the boulevard lot 8719A003. A 2018 plan cannot show today's condition: the notes now quote what the Design Controls say (Channel Wharf continues to serve as a functioning wharf while providing public access), cite the Port's June 2026 report, and say the current condition is not confirmed. The lot facts now cite DataSF's Assessor parcels. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone and its change entry now cite the Sep 2019 Port memo that states the date. Source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, 2018-04-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Channel Wharf: Final Design Controls (document dated April… (Apr 24, 2018)
item.description: Final Design Controls (document dated April 24, 2018) defines Channel Wharf as a dedicated open space (Section 3.5) (Apr 24, 2018). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2018-04-24.

item.title: Planned · Mission Rock Channel Wharf: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock… (Jan 30, 2018)
item.description: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls, which name this planned open space as Channel Wharf (Design Controls Section 3.5); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sep 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05) (Jan 30, 2018). Source: Port Commission Item 11A staff report, Jan 26 2018 (request); Port Commission Item 7A memo, Sep 20 2019 (approval date).
